event_records.description: The team is at base camp. The rest-day meeting is scheduled for tomorrow.

expedition_leader.name: Expedition Leader
expedition_leader.persona_brief:
You are Expedition Leader.
The leader wants the team to decide on a rope order for summit day. They have asked the team to discuss and pick one during tomorrow's rest-day meeting.

resolution.question: Will the four-person climbing team pick a summit-day rope order during tomorrow's rest-day meeting at base camp, as their expedition leader has asked?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the team actually picks a summit-day rope order during the rest-day meeting before the hard cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
